title: VoiceUserLine - Data API
description: Represents a user’s forwarding phone number.

IsCustomCallerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsCustomCallerId.description: Indicates whether the number is a custom caller ID (true) or not (false).

IsVerified.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update

Name.description: The name of the phone number.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the phone number.

UserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UserId.description: The ID of the user using the phone number.

VendorVerifiedCallerIdKey.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
VendorVerifiedCallerIdKey.description: The ID for a custom phone number provided by the Sales Dialer service provider.

VoiceVendorInfoId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
VoiceVendorInfoId.description: The ID of the related Sales Dialer service provider.

special_access_rules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **VoiceUserLineOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **VoiceUserLineShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
